title: Bronze Armor Touchup
description: Some tweaks to the textures of the Bronze Armor mod
body:
This resource pack touches up some textures of the [bronze armor](https://modrinth.com/mod/bronze-armor) mod.

![Items from Bronze Armor mod with new textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/gQIDHQ1g/images/266c504fbfbbb7f881682a7583416d758ad04cff.png)

![Blocks from Bronze Armor mod with new textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/gQIDHQ1g/images/a3ef2279fe47a4b668a0c8fd16c5ceec113763ea.png)

Bonus additions:
- The bronze bookshelf from [iron bookshelves](https://modrinth.com/mod/iron-bookshelves) has had its textures updated to match. You will still need to find some way to make it craftable and usable with Bronze Armor's bronze though.
- The bronze and tin knives from [delightful](https://modrinth.com/mod/delightful) have had their colors updated to match. You will still need to find some way to make them craftable and usable with Bronze Armor's bronze and tin though.
